steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const cs=g.wildlife.animals.filter(a=>a.species==='caribou'); const a=cs[0]; const px=a.x-45, pz=a.z+15; for(const c of cs){c.state='graze'; c.t=60;} g.player.place(px,pz,0); g.player.tool='rifle'; g.viewmodel.setTool('rifle'); window.__aimAt=(a)=>{const P=g.player; const dx=a.x-P.pos.x, dz=a.z-P.pos.z; const d=Math.hypot(dx,dz); P.yaw=Math.atan2(-dx,-dz); P.pitch=Math.atan2(a.y+a.cfg.height*0.72*a.scale-(P.pos.y+P.eye), d); return d;}; window.__cari=a; return 'caribou at '+a.x.toFixed(0)+','+a.z.toFixed(0)+' count '+cs.length})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const a=__cari; if(!a.dead){ a.hp=1; a.state='graze'; a.t=60; a.speed=0; g.hunting.boltT=0; __aimAt(a); g.player.lookSway.x=0; g.player.lookSway.y=0; __rhf.press('primary'); } return 'retry'})()
__rhf.press('secondary'); (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const a=__cari; g.player.place(a.x+2.5,a.z,0); return 'walk to it'})()
